# Kenney Interface Sounds — selected source files

These three original OGG files and `License.txt` were extracted unchanged from
Kenney Interface Sounds 1.0, downloaded from the official source on 2026-10-09.
The pack is CC0 1.0 Universal. The unchanged vendor license is `License.txt`.

- Source page: <https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds>
- Official archive: <https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/interface-sounds/fa43c1dd4d-1677589452/kenney_interface-sounds.zip>
- Archive SHA256: `f2193d072726d6758a5f7871b2dcc54dcce0d5c35c6f0a62f92549b327c81232`
- Archive size: 834,536 bytes
- License: <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>

Only `Audio/confirmation_001.ogg`, `Audio/error_004.ogg`, and
`Audio/switch_001.ogg` are retained. The full 100-sound archive and unrelated
pack files are omitted. `manifest.json` records the acquisition, hashes,
conversion and measured output properties.

The Unreal-compatible 16-bit PCM WAV conversions and reproducible Blender
script live in `art/cc0_feedback/`. See `docs/CC0_FEEDBACK.md` for the intended
settlement uses and import guidance.
